description:
Late shift. High stakes. Six US time zones. One shot per call.

This is a genuine job posting - not a ghost job!

Let's skip the part where we tell you this is “an exciting opportunity in a dynamic environment.” You've read that sentence four hundred times and seen it all. 

Here's what's actually true:

We need an experienced, financially literate Closer who speaks English on a native or C2 Level, can pick up a phone at 3:30pm, talk to a stranger with eight figures in a brokerage account somewhere in Wyoming or Connecticut, get them to sign a convertible promissory note before their assistant walks in with coffee. That's it. That's the job. Everything else is detail.

Who We Are

Meridion AG runs the show from Monheim & Düsseldorf. Our US arm, Meridion Dynamics Inc., builds intelligent software and smart energy technology. But you're not selling the product. You're closing the investment that funds it. Different animal, different muscle.

Aufgaben

What You'll Actually Do

Take warm(ish) leads from our setters - accredited US investors who already know we called - and close them on convertible promissory notes.

Walk investors through the accreditation process without losing them to paperwork fatigue.

Hold the line, know the terms cold, and answer the “wait, what happens if you don't hit your IPO timeline” question without blinking.

If a setter is running low on appointments, out sick or on vacation, you step in and run up to 100 outbound cold calls that day to convert…

Powering Great Work
We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. summary: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M),…
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen
Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation
The opportunity
Pitstops are the local shops that power Relay. Every day, thousands of corner shops, newsagents and convenience stores take in parcels from our vans, hand them to couriers on bikes and in cars, and serve customers dropping off and picking up. They’re the reason we can deliver faster and cheaper than the big carriers. We’ve grown from a few hundred pitstops to thousands in two years. Next is the rest of the UK and the…

description:
The Software Developer I, Connector role supports Trial Interactive’s proprietary platform, Connector - the cloud-based integrations that move life science data between clients’ clinical systems (for example EDC/eCRF and IRT systems) and Trial Interactive’s life science products. Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the role helps build and maintain connectors, keeps client data flowing accurately, and resolves issues when it does not.
This is a blended role, covering development and maintenance up until handling client requests. This role works closely with the Solutions, DevOps and Engineering teams.

DESCRIPTION
As part of the Development and maintenance responsibility, the resource handles:
• Develop, test and maintain connector components in C# on .NET (AWS Lambda), including the parsers and mappers that convert source-system data (API payloads, files) into the formats required by the Trial Interactive CTMS and eTMF.
• Configure and extend mappings for new studies, sites and visit/status definitions on existing connectors, reusing existing modules wherever possible.
• Assist in the technical onboarding of new clients and studies: connector configuration, test runs in non-production environments, and verification before go-live.
• Work with the AWS services connectors are built on (Lambda, SQS, S3, EventBridge/Step Functions, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and make small, reviewed infrastructure changes using Terraform under supervision.

description:
Lead Product Designer 
📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)
💰 £70k-£90k (negotiable)

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer - the most senior individual contributor for design within a product domain. This is predominantly an IC role: you'll set the design bar for an entire domain through the quality of your own work, the patterns you contribute, and the way you raise the designers around you. We're flexible on this for the right person, if you've got management experience, or want to line-manage one or two designers alongside the IC work, let's talk.

We want someone who is tired of the "feature factory" grind, who is past needing to be told what's worth working on, and who is ready to set the design direction for a domain in one of the most exciting PropTech companies in the UK.

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.
At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. Lead Product Designers drive roadmap conversations alongside their product and engineering counterparts, not respond to them.

summary: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise.…
description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.
About the Role
Summary
Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups.

We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership…

description:
À propos de Symrise
Symrise est un fournisseur mondial de fragrances, de parfums, d'arômes, d'ingrédients actifs cosmétiques et d'ingrédients fonctionnels. L'entreprise compte parmi les leaders mondiaux de son secteur et dessert des fabricants de parfums, de cosmétiques, de produits alimentaires et de boissons, ainsi que l'industrie pharmaceutique et les producteurs de compléments nutritionnels et d'aliments pour animaux.
Vos missions
Rattaché(e) au Secrétaire Général, avec un rattachement fonctionnel au Regional Head of Safety EAME, vous définissez, pilotez et faites évoluer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy.
Véritable partenaire de la Direction du site et des responsables opérationnels, vous veillez à intégrer pleinement les enjeux EHS aussi bien dans les activités quotidiennes que dans les projets de transformation, de développement et d'investissement du site.
Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

Définir et déployer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy, en cohérence avec les objectifs EHS globaux de Symrise et les priorités du business.

Manager et développer l'équipe EHS, en définissant les priorités et en veillant à disposer des compétences et ressources nécessaires.

Identifier, évaluer et prioriser les principaux risques environnementaux, santé et sécurité, et assurer la mise en œuvre de plans de prévention adaptés.

Développer une véritable culture de la sécurité et de la prévention auprès de l'ensemble des activités du site : laboratoires, bureaux…

title: Consultant cybersécurité - ASM / EASM
summary: U.NEAT est une société spécialisée en cybersécurité et propose des services d’expertises à travers ses pôles : Expertises : assistance technique SecOps / DevSecOps  Consulting : activités de conseil…
description:
U.NEAT est une société spécialisée en cybersécurité et propose des services d’expertises à travers ses pôles :
Expertises : assistance technique SecOps / DevSecOps

Consulting : activités de conseil en SSI / GRC

Cyber Defense Center : service SOC managé et CSIRT

Vos missions
Chez l’un de nos clients, au sein d'une équipe sécurité, vous interviendrez sur les activités ASM/EASM, avec une attention particulière à la sécurité DNS. 
Vous démarrez par un état des lieux, vous construisez la feuille de route avec le management sécurité, puis vous la mettez en œuvre avec les équipes techniques.
Faire l’état des lieux : processus existants (RACI), outillage utilisé, zones insuffisamment couvertes

Construire et faire valider la feuille de route : objectif, étapes, livrables et plus-value sécurité de chacun, validés par le management sécurité

Fiabiliser le référentiel des actifs exposés : exploiter et optimiser l’ASM pour découvrir domaines, sous-domaines et services exposés, et tenir ce référentiel à jour

Automatiser l’analyse d’impact : évaluer la criticité de chaque détection en croisant données techniques, dépendances et contexte métier

Prioriser et piloter les remédiations : classer les risques selon l’exposition, l’exploitabilité et l’impact, accompagner les équipes techniques et vérifier que les corrections sont effectives

Mesurer : définir et faire évoluer les indicateurs de risque et d’efficacité des remédiations

Renforcer la sécurité DNS : faire évoluer les méthodes…

For this position we source for our sister company Troostwijk. 

About us
Troostwijk & the TBAuctions group are part of one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support.

As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business.

The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market.

You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships.

Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market.

Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust.

Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations.

Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers.

Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps.

Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion.

title: Location Data engineer
summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals,…
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.
You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.
This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:
Making Sense of Data
Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

Building Data Products
Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and…

description:

At machineMD in Bern we’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our existing test infrastructure gives you a starting point, with room to introduce your own ideas and additional tools as you connect and improve how we test.

description:
Middelharnis, Netherlands | Thermoheat B.V.

Join Thermoheat B.V. and help shape the future of HR in an international industrial environment.

We are looking for a HR Generalist (m/f/d) to support and develop our HR processes across the Thermoheat Group. This is a part-time position (20–25 hours/week).

Company Overview

Thermoheat B.V. is an established company with over 40 years of experience in the refractory industry and part of the internationally active LOEWE Group, a family-owned business founded in 1962.

With locations in the Netherlands and Portugal, Thermoheat delivers tailor-made refractory solutions for industrial clients worldwide. Our core markets include petrochemical, steel, aluminum, non-ferrous metals, energy, waste incineration, ceramics and glass.

Our portfolio covers the full range of refractory products and services, including thermal seals, refractory pre-shapes, and passive fire protection systems, all from a single source.

We are VCA certified, ISO 9001:2015 compliant, and audited according to NEN 4400-1, ensuring the highest standards in quality, safety, and compliance.

Your Role

You will take ownership of both operational HR tasks and strategic HR initiatives, working closely with management to strengthen our organization and people development.

Key Responsibilities

HR Strategy & Policies

In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders.

Role Overview

Running one AI model across many chips is a distributed systems problem: a host and many chips exchanging data over links, waiting on each other, and failing in ways no single chip would. As a Senior Distributed Systems Engineer, you will help us simulate that system before the hardware exists. You will work with the chip modeling, SDK, and runtime teams to build the simulators that stand in for the host, the links, and the protocols between…

Grip is the AI-powered, end-to-end event platform built for engagement. The flexible system helps commercial event organisers like Ascential, Hyve, Emerald and Clarion Events boost revenue by establishing, maintaining and tracking relationships between participants over multiple events. This is possible because Grip goes beyond networking. It combines AI with billions of interactions happening across the platform with a powerful event management system, seamless registration and award-winning mobile event app so participants meet the right people at the right time.
🚀 The Role
We're looking for a Product Manager who thinks agentically, someone who approaches data not as an end in itself, but as the foundation that makes intelligent, AI-powered systems possible.
Grip is building toward a platform where AI agents act on behalf of organisers and participants. To get there, the data that underpins that layer needs to be right. That's where this role starts: getting hands-on with data ingestion, understanding how data moves through the platform, and building the clean, well-structured data layer that agentic systems depend on.
You'll work on system integrations, ETL pipelines and CDP tracking, not as traditional data plumbing work, but with a clear eye on what the AI layer above it will need. Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Quality Lead plays a critical role in supporting the day-to-day activities of the Aircover Quality program from the Airbnb India (ACC) site. This role sets the standard for excellence in Quality across the Aircover organization and requires a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can operate credibly across both partner-facing and internal audiences.

Reporting to the Aircover Quality Manager, the QA supports quality performance across the entire partner QA network. Within this remit and without being dedicated to any single team the QA also supports the internal Aircover Claims Experience (ACE) and Service Recovery team, along with their respective stakeholders. 

Across both, the QA partners with internal stakeholders to drive continuous improvement, through transaction monitoring, calibration, root cause analysis, business case development, and reporting, ensuring all assigned work is completed within deadlines. title: Program Manager, North America Policy

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Airbnb’s public policy team aims to work closely with politicians, regulators, and legislators to educate them about Airbnb and the “sharing” or “collaborative” economy, highlight the significant social and economic impact our business has on local areas, and showcase best practices from around the world. We want policy makers to understand the regulatory challenges that affect our host community and find solutions that are good for cities and our thriving local communities.

We structure our work in local campaign groups, drawing on a wide range of tools and campaign disciplines - from detailed policy work, through high-impact partnerships, proactive media relations, community organizing, digital platforms and content, polling, and innovative data science and research.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Program Manager will support the priorities of the US & Canada Campaigns Director as they execute  strategy and initiatives in coordination with global and regional campaigns and cross functional partners.

A Typical Day:

description:
Functie  Reliability engineer

Beschrijving functie

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 

Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

description:
Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About the team

Join our Product team to shape the future of financial access and infrastructure. We're not just improving global payments—we're reinventing them. You'll bridge traditional banking systems and blockchain protocols, pioneering entirely new ways for money and commerce to move seamlessly around the world. This is your chance to lead meaningful innovation from day one, redefining the way businesses and people…

About AMBOSS
We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. Custom objects allow businesses to define custom data models in Stripe, ensuring Stripe reflects how their business operates. A business might have data that doesn’t fit standard Stripe objects, such as Shipments, Reservations, or InsurancePolicies. Once defined in Stripe, that custom data can be used with Stripe-native objects, such as Customers, Subscriptions, and Invoices. Companies can keep their existing system of record and bring over what their Stripe integration needs, or use custom objects as the system of record for that data.

Custom objects are the data pillar of Stripe’s extensibility platform, which consists of Stripe Apps, Stripe Workflows, scripts, and extension points.

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

At Airbnb, our mission is to create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. In India, that means championing local culture, fostering meaningful connections, and empowering our hosts and guests to experience the magic of this vibrant country. Behind every unforgettable stay is an extraordinary team. We are the Airbnb Talent team, playful, curious, and fiercely committed to preserving and elevating Airbnb’s mission. We partner with brilliant, inspiring individuals and empower them to raise the bar on how we work, learn, and grow together. If you’re excited by a role that blends strategic impact with hands-on partnership, read on!

The Difference You Will Make:

As our Senior Talent Partner for India, you will be the primary People/Talent point of contact for our India-based teams, while also serving as the go-to advisor for the broader Global Operations (Ops) organisation on the ground. Reporting to the Talent Director, APAC & India (based in Singapore), you will:

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…
